title: Add tests for import engines and new CLI options
description: Write robust test cases in test_pipeline.py and test_cli.py. Cover ruff subprocess execution (and syntax errors), isort configuration path preservation, and --section-only / --strategy-overrides CLI behavior.

title: Add --section-only and --strategy-overrides CLI options
description: Implement --section-only (comma-separated list of sections) and --strategy-overrides (e.g. functions=alpha,classes=keep) options for csort run, check, and diff commands. Restrict reordered sections and dynamically override configured strategies respectively.

title: Propagate filename context to import engines
description: Update sort_imports(source, cfg) function signature to accept filename: str = '<unknown>'. Forward filename from sort_source/would_change down to sort_imports. In ruff engine, use --stdin-filename to resolve local ruff.toml properly. In isort engine, supply the folder path of the filename to isort.Config(settings_path=...) to respect local configurations.

title: Parse ruff_args option in configuration
description: Parse ruff_args key inside [tool.csort.imports] or [imports] tables in config.py. Store it in ruff_extra_args within the Config dataclass so users can pass custom flags to the Ruff subprocess.

title: Implement Ruff import sorting engine in pipeline
description: Implement pluggable, subprocess-based delegation to Ruff (ruff check --select I --fix -) when imports.engine = 'ruff' is configured.
